runner.networkUserAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 11; moto g power (2022)) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/153.0.0.0 Mobile Safari/537.36
runner.cdnTemperature: Unknown; Google controls runner location. Production HTML served `Netlify Edge; fwd=miss` from Netlify Durable cache in our own checks; static chunks are immutable.

protocol: Three rounds over all 11 routes, one route at a time, 09:12–09:24 UTC. Same-route captures are 2.3–6.3 minutes apart. Every capture has a distinct Lighthouse fetchTime later than the deploy publication (09:07:47 UTC); none was excluded as a cached repeat. Round 3 overlapped the read-only deployed Playwright suite (single worker) from the verifier's own network, which is unrelated to Google's runner but recorded for completeness.
precision: Displayed values (as rendered by PageSpeed) are used for medians, the same as the Oct 3/Oct 5 evidence. Precise Lighthouse numeric values are retained per sample.
